decision: User permits reuse of AST-developed mechanics/features in Core and other engines; AST is a named 1415 starting scenario, not a separately maintained engine.

entries.receiving_owner: Core record_player_action; voluntary selection and exact-intent host
entries.limit: No unrequested speech, spending, allegiance, movement or successor.
A historical reference is not automatically known.
No healing, HP model, diagnosis or physiological rate is inferred.

entries.receiving_owner: Core stock, obligations, orders, capacities and activity ledger
entries.limit: Custody, ownership and available quantity retain separate meanings; full asset/law procedures remain scoped.

entries.receiving_owner: Core observation frontier and shared capacities
entries.limit: Use actual observed dependencies, not campaign-specific manual footprints.

entries.receiving_owner: Core obligations, received orders and delegation
entries.limit: No employment, wage or permanent allegiance from background text.

entries.receiving_owner: Core record_design; supported tracked-work research receivers
entries.limit: A drawing is not an item, completed work or demonstrated performance.

entries.receiving_owner: Temporal registry and explicit control assignment
entries.limit: No automatic successor, inherited skills, memory, office or cloned stock.

entries.receiving_owner: Recovered d100 thresholds retained in source as a named profile reference
entries.limit: Not adopted as a universal genre rule; missing effect, skill and modifier models remain unresolved.

entries.receiving_owner: Core evidence/work ownership; genre learning procedures
entries.limit: No XP, learning rate or time-unit conversion selected.

entries.receiving_owner: Generic actor identity, asset and knowledge owners
entries.limit: Animal behavior and riding capability need appropriate procedures and actual conditions.

entries.receiving_owner: Generic journal, exact declarations and scoped Chronicle
